name: Boteh
description: Paisley: curling teardrop botehs, a small one nested inside each large one, turning head to tail from square to square.

code.style: --rule: ( --a: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); --r: @calc((@x + @y) % 2 * 180 + @r(-12, 12))deg; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--r)); transform: rotate(@var(--r)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(@var(--a)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--boteh); clip-path: @var(--boteh); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; top: 34%; width: 44%; height: 44%; background-color: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--boteh); clip-path: @var(--boteh); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --boteh: @shape(split: 160; x: sin(t); y: (1 + sin(t)) * cos(t) / 1.3 - 1.3 * ((1 - sin(t)) / 2)^3; rotate: 90; scale: .72); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
